svg.title: Why Geothermal Systems Scale
svg.desc: Calcium, silica, magnesium and iron, plus dissolved CO₂, oxygen and H₂S, may be present in geothermal fluids. Pressure, temperature and gas changes can cause precipitation. Source lists calcium carbonate, calcium silicate, silica, calcite and barite deposits. Hardened deposits restrict flow and production. Deposit and water analysis inform treatment.
